title: Wayang Puppet Theatre, 2 dollars

specs.Decoration: selective antique finish, selective gilding, digital printing

descriptionPlain: Description Original numismatic design High-end decorative techniques One ounce of finest silver Dive into the enchanting world of the Wayang Puppet Theatre with our exclusive coin series. Each coin in this captivating collection brings to life a different aspect of the traditional Indonesian shadow puppetry. Renowned for its intricate designs and profound storytelling, Wayang Puppet Theatre is an art form steeped in cultural heritage and spiritual depth. These coins celebrate not only the artistic beauty of the puppets but also the rich narratives they convey.
